names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 4 martie, «Sfântul Mucenic Pavel».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Παύλος και Ιουλιανή και οι μαζί μ' αυτούς μαρτυρήσαντες Στρατόνικος, Κοδράτος και Ακάκιος οι δήμιοι», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 4 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети мученици Павле и Јулијана.“, which names two people; this man's own name is taken out of it, with the rank word мученици left off and Свети, which is not a rank. The heading gives no epithet and does not name Ptolemais, which this folder's English name carries and which the body of the entry supplies.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: “Мчч. Павла, Иулиании и прочих с ними (ок. 273)”.

feast.note: saint.gr's own page for them closes «Η μνήμη των Αγίων επαναλαμβάνεται και στις 17 Αυγούστου» — their memory is kept again on 17 August (https://www.saint.gr/3792/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). That is the day this folder's Russian row already holds, in the Julian reckoning. The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so his Greek row is the day page that was read.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Παύλος και Ιουλιανή και οι μαζί μ' αυτούς μαρτυρήσαντες Στρατόνικος, Κοδράτος και Ακάκιος οι δήμιοι»

attestations.note: The page makes Paul and Juliana brother and sister and sets them «στα χρόνια του αυτοκράτορα Αυρηλιανού (270 - 275 μ.Χ.)», which is the reign this folder's own date already rests on. It puts them at Ptolemais, has them denounced to Aurelian as he passed through their city, and names the three executioners — Stratonicus, Codratus and Acacius — who marvelled at their courage under torture, confessed Christ and were beheaded on the spot; the two were then burnt with lighted torches and beheaded. The day's line names all three executioners, so each is kept as a folder of his own. The page prints two distichs, one for the pair and one for the three, names no relic and gives no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 17.03.2026 (4. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Павле и Јулијана.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry. Its heading names the brother and the sister and nobody else, so the three executioners the corpus keeps on this menologion day from the Greek and Russian lines — `stratonicus-the-executioner`, `codratus-the-executioner` and `acacius-the-executioner` — took no row from it: the body says only that many pagans were converted by the wonders and that some of them were beheaded too, and names none of them. The Prologue gives the emperor as Aurelian and the year as 273, which falls inside the interval this folder already holds, 268 to 278, and narrower than it; a sourced interval is not narrowed on a reader's reading, so nothing was changed. The stored Serbian form is the bare forename, which `paul-of-jamnia` already holds off a line of its own; that fold is recorded in the run's findings.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoințele lor, cununile nestricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au și ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuiește sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Pavel și sora sa Iuliana

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received crowns of incorruption from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength they overcame their tormentors, and broke the strengthless daring of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ our God, save Thou our souls.
